classification: pre-registered cost-stress confirmation of the R377 sealed-window result; research-only
question: Does the R377 hold-30 centre advantage survive 3x and 5x execution costs on the sealed 2025-05-06 through 2026-11-05 window, or is it an artefact of 2x cost assumptions?

5x.note: 5x is a diagnostic only, as fixed in gate policy v2.

decision_rules: The sealed-window advantage is robust only if 3x clears every gate; 5x is reported but never used as a hard rejection.
2x must exactly reproduce the R377 sealed centre before any stress result is accepted.
No parameter may be changed based on the sealed window.
No leverage, paper target, order or production change is permitted.
known_limits: The sealed window is about 17 months and overlaps the 2025-2026 regime.
Same B-sleeve curves and same current HS300 membership / industry backfill as R371-R377.
Only the centre and the 20-day control are evaluated under 3x/5x; the full 27-cell grid is not re-materialised.
5x is diagnostic and is not a hard rejection condition.
